subject.title: docs: map the algorithmic closure system

question: After the dependent implementation stack lands, does this guide distinguish current operational behavior from normative or planned architecture accurately enough to become the durable system map?
rationale: CI cannot resolve cross-system architecture semantics, and the document intentionally covers partial and in-rollout layers whose final boundaries depend on maintainer-owned implementation decisions.

options.title: Verify after rebase
options.body: Keep the draft open, rebase after the implementation stack lands, and complete an area-owner semantic audit before merge.

options.title: Adopt as normative design
options.body: Merge only if maintainers explicitly accept the rollout-stage statements as design contracts rather than descriptions of fully landed behavior.

recommendation.title: Verify after rebase
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open, rebase after the implementation stack lands, and complete an area-owner semantic audit before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository member authored and iteratively aligned the document's recovery, rollout, and lease-ordering model, making them the strongest available coordinator for cross-area review.
